test_mesh_rasterizer: test the MeshRasterizer class by rasterizing a single icosphere mesh and comparing output against a reference binary mask image
test_mesh_rasterizer_opengl: test the MeshRasterizerOpenGL class by rasterizing meshes and comparing barycentric coordinates and z-buffer values against the standard MeshRasterizer
test_point_rasterizer: test the PointsRasterizer class by rasterizing a pointcloud derived from an icosphere and comparing the output against a reference image
test_fisheye_against_perspective: test that FishEyeCameras rasterization output matches PerspectiveCameras output when distortion parameters are disabled for both mesh and point rasterizers
convert_image_to_binary_mask: create a function that loads an image file and converts it to a binary mask by thresholding pixels equal to the maximum value
